lead_summary.zh: 美期中選舉開票；川普稱年底停對以援助
lead_summary.en: US midterm count begins; Trump says Israel aid to end

title.zh: 美期中選舉投票結束　各州陸續開票
title.en: US midterm polls close as states begin counting

body.zh: 美國期中選舉首批投票所於美東時間 3 日晚間 6 時（台灣 4 日上午 7 時）在印第安納與肯塔基州部分地區關閉，各州陸續開票，阿拉斯加最後一批票所於台灣時間下午 2 時關閉。民主黨須在眾院淨增 3 席、參院淨增 4 席才能取得兩院多數；美聯社統計提前投票逾 5,900 萬張。CNN 出口民調顯示約 6 成選民不認同川普施政，約 9 成將生活成本列為重要考量；川普則呼籲支持者把這次投票當成他本人參選，佛州州長德桑提斯坦言共和黨可能丟掉一兩場關鍵選戰。
body.en: The first US midterm polls closed at 6 p.m. Eastern on the 3rd (7 a.m. on the 4th in Taiwan) in parts of Indiana and Kentucky, and counting is under way, with the last polls in Alaska closing at 2 p.m. Taiwan time. Democrats need a net gain of three House seats and four Senate seats to win majorities; the AP counted more than 59 million early votes. A CNN exit poll found about 60% of voters disapprove of President Trump's performance and about 90% cited the cost of living as a major factor, while Trump urged supporters to vote as if he were on the ballot and Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said Republicans could lose one or two top races.

title.zh: 川普：年底起停止每年 40 億美元對以援助
title.en: Trump says US$4 billion yearly aid to Israel to end after this year

body.zh: 川普 3 日接受福斯新聞專訪時表示，他已與以色列總理納坦雅胡達成共識，美國每年約 40 億美元的對以援助將在今年底後停止，對以軍售則不受影響，理由是以色列已不再需要這筆錢。現行美以備忘錄每年提供約 38 億美元軍援、效期至 2028 年 9 月，川普未說明如何提前終止。以色列反對派領袖艾森柯特批評國防部門是從媒體得知此事，白宮與納坦雅胡辦公室未回應路透詢問。
body.en: In a Fox News interview on the 3rd, President Trump said he and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had agreed that roughly US$4 billion in annual US aid to Israel would end after this year, while arms sales would continue, saying Israel no longer needs the money. The current memorandum of understanding provides about US$3.8 billion a year in military aid through September 2028, and Trump did not explain how it would end early. Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot said the defense establishment learned of the change from the media; the White House and Netanyahu's office did not respond to Reuters.

title.zh: 伊朗堅持七項條件　否則不重開荷莫茲海峽
title.en: Iran insists on seven conditions before reopening Hormuz

body.zh: 伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷札伊 3 日表示，美方對伊朗訴求的回應缺乏說服力，除非美國明確回應並落實七項條件，否則荷莫茲海峽不會重新開放。伊朗官員提及的要求包括解除石油制裁、結束海上封鎖及解凍資產；卡達外交部則說調解團仍在德黑蘭斡旋。川普同日表示不想造成大量傷亡，但必要時美國將採取行動。
body.en: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said on the 3rd that Washington's response to Iran's demands was unconvincing and that the Strait of Hormuz would not reopen unless the US clearly answers and implements seven conditions. Demands cited by an Iranian official include lifting oil sanctions, ending the naval blockade and unfreezing assets, while Qatar's foreign ministry said its mediators were still holding talks in Tehran. President Trump said the same day he did not want to cause heavy casualties but that the US would act if necessary.

title.zh: 格陵蘭議會通過美丹格安全協議
title.en: Greenland's parliament approves security pact with US and Denmark

body.zh: 格陵蘭自治議會 4 日以 16 票贊成、7 票棄權、無人反對，批准與美國及丹麥在 9 月簽署的安全協議。協議允許美方在格陵蘭新建兩座軍事基地，並禁止歐盟與北約以外國家進入當地戰略地區，用意在阻擋中俄透過投資擴大影響力。丹麥國會預計 19 日表決，兩國議會均通過並通知美方後協議即生效。
body.en: Greenland's parliament voted 16 in favor with seven abstentions and none against on the 4th to approve a security agreement signed with the US and Denmark in September. The deal allows the US to build two new military bases on the island and bars countries outside the EU and NATO from its strategic areas, aiming to block Chinese or Russian influence through investment. Denmark's parliament is expected to vote on the 19th, and the pact takes effect once both legislatures approve it and notify Washington.

title.zh: 一年兩起高鐵重大事故　西班牙交通部長請辭
title.en: Spain's transport minister quits after two major rail crashes in a year

body.zh: 西班牙交通部長普恩特 3 日宣布辭職，表示在一年內發生兩起重大高鐵事故後，交通部長不能繼續留任。10 月 28 日兩列高速列車在托雷多省附近追撞，造成至少 69 人死亡；普恩特 30 日曾指出控制中心人員多項疏失，當時仍表示不會辭職。西班牙政府已宣布提供 3,000 萬歐元給罹難者家屬與傷者。
body.en: Spanish Transport Minister Óscar Puente announced his resignation on the 3rd, saying a transport minister could not stay on after two major high-speed rail accidents in less than a year. Two high-speed trains collided near Toledo province on October 28, killing at least 69 people; on the 30th Puente blamed multiple errors at the rail control center and said at the time he would not resign. The government has announced €30 million in aid for victims and their families.

title.zh: AMD 營收年增 45%　盤後股價大漲約 8%
title.en: AMD revenue jumps 45%; shares up about 8% after hours

body.zh: AMD 3 日盤後公布第三季營收 133.8 億美元，年增 45%，高於 LSEG 預估的 130.9 億美元，調整後每股盈餘 2.09 美元，也優於預期的 1.95 美元。資料中心營收較去年同期接近翻倍，占總營收比重由 47% 升至 64%；公司預估第四季營收約 170 億美元，高於市場預期的 162 億美元，毛利率約 55%，略低於預期。執行長蘇姿丰表示有信心未來數年維持強勁成長，股價盤後大漲約 8%。
body.en: AMD reported third-quarter revenue of US$13.38 billion after the bell on the 3rd, up 45% and above the LSEG estimate of US$13.09 billion, with adjusted EPS of US$2.09 versus the expected US$1.95. Data center revenue nearly doubled from a year earlier, rising to 64% of total sales from 47%; the company guided fourth-quarter revenue to about US$17 billion, above the US$16.2 billion consensus, with gross margin of about 55%, slightly below estimates. CEO Lisa Su said she is confident of sustaining very strong growth in coming years, and the shares rose about 8% after hours.

title.zh: 美 9 月職缺增至 750 萬　十年債殖利率跳升
title.en: US job openings rise to 7.5 million; 10-year yield jumps

body.zh: 美國勞工統計局 3 日公布，9 月職缺數為 750 萬個、職缺率 4.5%，8 月修正為 720 萬個；離職人數升至 340 萬，裁員與解僱則為 160 萬。數據優於預期，壓低美國公債價格，十年期公債殖利率上升 5.8 個基點至 4.951%，為 9 月 28 日以來最大單日升幅，兩年期殖利率升至 4.612%。
body.en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics said on the 3rd that job openings stood at 7.5 million in September, a rate of 4.5%, with August revised to 7.2 million; quits rose to 3.4 million, while layoffs and discharges were 1.6 million. The stronger-than-expected data pushed Treasury prices lower, lifting the 10-year yield 5.8 basis points to 4.951%, its biggest one-day rise since September 28, and the 2-year yield to 4.612%.

title.zh: 蘋果執行長：記憶體價格明年續漲
title.en: Apple CEO warns memory prices will keep rising next year

body.zh: 蘋果執行長特納斯表示，記憶體市場情勢前所未見、價格已在歷史高點，預期本季還會上漲、明年持續攀升；蘋果預估本季毛利率 45% 至 46%，低於分析師預期及上季的 47.9%。蘋果正以調漲售價、提前採購與壓低其他零組件成本因應，股價 3 日收跌 1.9% 至 331.90 美元。分析師指出，華邦電與南亞科也是蘋果的記憶體供應商。
body.en: Apple CEO John Ternus said conditions in the memory market are unprecedented, with prices at record levels and expected to rise again this quarter and keep climbing next year; Apple guided this quarter's gross margin to 45–46%, below analyst expectations and the previous quarter's 47.9%. The company is responding by raising prices, buying memory early and cutting other component costs, and its shares closed down 1.9% at US$331.90 on the 3rd. Analysts noted that Taiwan's Winbond and Nanya also supply Apple with memory.

title.zh: 台達電股價近乎腰斬　市值遭鴻海超車
title.en: Delta's shares nearly halve as Hon Hai overtakes it in market value

body.zh: 台達電 3 日收跌 6.27% 至 1,270 元，為近 8 個月新低，較 5 月盤中高點 2,585 元幾乎腰斬，市值 3.2988 兆元被鴻海的 3.4555 兆元超越，退居上市公司第 4 名，台積電與聯發科仍居前二。台達電第三季歸屬母公司淨利 234.95 億元、季減 6.5%，毛利率降至 34.08%；董事長鄭平表示 AI 需求不變，第四季營收將高於第三季。鴻海則公告將於 12 日舉行第三季法說會。
body.en: Delta Electronics fell 6.27% to NT$1,270 on the 3rd, its lowest close in nearly eight months and almost half its intraday high of NT$2,585 in May; its NT$3.2988 trillion market value was overtaken by Hon Hai's NT$3.4555 trillion, dropping it to fourth among listed companies behind TSMC and MediaTek. Delta's third-quarter net profit attributable to the parent was NT$23.495 billion, down 6.5% from the previous quarter, with gross margin slipping to 34.08%; chairman Ping Cheng said AI demand is unchanged and fourth-quarter revenue will exceed the third quarter's. Hon Hai announced it will hold its third-quarter investor conference on the 12th.

title.zh: 財報行情分歧　支付股漲、電商股跌
title.en: Earnings split stocks: Fiserv up 12%, Shopify down nearly 9%

body.zh: 支付業者 Fiserv 上調成本節省目標並計畫買回庫藏股，股價 3 日收漲 12.46%。電商平台 Shopify 第三季營收 37.4 億美元、年增 32%，但略低於市場預期的 37.5 億美元，訂閱毛利等指標也未達標，股價收跌 8.74%；研究機構 Gartner 則重挫 13.37%。
body.en: Payments company Fiserv raised its cost-savings target and announced plans to buy back shares, sending its stock up 12.46% on the 3rd. E-commerce platform Shopify posted third-quarter revenue of US$3.74 billion, up 32% but just below the expected US$3.75 billion, and missed on measures including subscription gross profit, closing down 8.74%; research firm Gartner sank 13.37%.

headline.zh: 外資賣超逾千億　台股重挫 1,612 點
headline.en: Foreign selling tops NT$100 billion as TAIEX sinks 1,612 points

body.zh: 加權指數 3 日開低走低，終場跌 1,612.60 點、跌幅 3.59%，為史上第 7 大單日跌點，上市逾千檔個股下跌、74 檔跌停。台積電跌 35 元收 2,295 元，聯發科重挫 7.43% 至 3,675 元，大立光跌停，記憶體、PCB 與光通訊族群賣壓沉重；新台幣盤中一度貶破 32.8 元。金管會表示，台股跌幅介於亞洲主要股市之間，主因國際股市波動、大型科技股財報與地緣政治不確定性，將持續關注市場變化。
body.en: The TAIEX opened lower and kept falling on the 3rd, closing down 1,612.60 points (3.59%), its seventh-largest one-day point drop on record, with more than 1,000 listed stocks lower and 74 at limit-down. TSMC lost NT$35 to NT$2,295, MediaTek sank 7.43% to NT$3,675 and Largan hit limit-down, while memory, PCB and optical-communications names were sold heavily; the Taiwan dollar briefly weakened past 32.8 per US dollar. The Financial Supervisory Commission said the drop was within the range of major Asian markets, citing global volatility, big-tech earnings and geopolitical uncertainty, and said it would keep monitoring the market.

flows_note.zh: 外資連 4 日賣超、4 日累計約 3,621 億元，單日金額為史上第 8 大；投信連 16 日買超。
flows_note.en: Foreign investors have been net sellers for four sessions, about NT$362.1 billion in total, and today's figure is the eighth-largest on record; investment trusts have been net buyers for 16 straight sessions.

headline.zh: 美股 11/3：晶片股反攻　費半漲 2.63%
headline.en: US close, Nov 3: chips rebound as SOX gains 2.63%

body.zh: 資金在期中選舉開票前重回半導體與 AI 股，AMD 漲 3.7%、輝達漲 2.3% 終止四連跌、美光漲 2.6%，台積電 ADR 漲 1.55% 站回 400 美元。蘋果因毛利率財測不如預期下跌 1.9%，標普 500 漲幅集中在少數大型科技股，多數成分股收低；9 月職缺數據強勁推升十年期公債殖利率至 4.951%，道瓊收黑。AMD 盤後公布財報優於預期，股價盤後大漲約 8%。
body.en: Money flowed back into chip and AI stocks ahead of the midterm count: AMD rose 3.7%, Nvidia gained 2.3% to end a four-day losing streak and Micron added 2.6%, while the TSMC ADR rose 1.55% to reclaim US$400. Apple fell 1.9% on a disappointing margin outlook, and the S&P 500's gains were concentrated in a few large tech names while most components fell; strong September job-openings data pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to 4.951%, and the Dow closed lower. AMD reported better-than-expected results after the bell and rose about 8% in after-hours trading.
